title: Chapter 286 Cruel Street Fighting
content:
Chapter 286 Cruel Street Fighting

You know, these blood-refined weapons devour blood souls to grow stronger. It is even more able to prevent these devouring powers from being in the hands of their own masters, and help their masters break through the bottleneck of cultivation.

Therefore, the 100,000 people Zhong Yu still had great expectations.

He spent the entire country's material resources and manpower to train these 100,000 elite armored soldiers who cultivated internal strength.

Moreover, when these elites joined the army, they were all eleven or twelve-year-old youths, and their own thinking was not very mature, so Zhong Yu continued to brainwash and control them, so that their loyalty to Zhong Yu was greatly enhanced, almost reaching the level of Loyalty.

Moreover, in the bodies of many people with potential, their initial internal force was not cultivated by themselves, but Zhong Yu extracted the internal force from his own body, and used it as a seed to water and grow.

Therefore, from a certain point of view, these people are Zhong Yu's clone puppets, but they just have their own consciousness.

With such a group of elites who obeyed him unconditionally, Zhong Yu naturally had no choice but to lose one of them, and would feel distressed for a long time.

Now that they are brought to the battlefield to participate in this war to destroy Qi, it is natural to use this war to refine those weapons.

And use this to train the future flowers of the empire that grew up under the care of Zhong Yu, and grow up quickly to meet the greater challenges in the near future, and at that time can also become an important force in your hands.

As for the elites who lost their lives in the process, Zhong Yu could only ignore them.

After all, what Zhong Yu wants is not a bunch of flowers in the greenhouse, but the strongest sword and shield of the empire that can open up the territory for him, cover up his strength, flatten him, and flatten him.

And those who can't become the sword and shield of the empire he wants can only die in the process and turn into fertile soil to provide nutrients for the more powerful people in the future.

Up to now, this plan has been implemented very smoothly. 100,000 weapons have been trained, and nearly 10,000 have been trained.

Already in the hands of their respective masters, they are shining brightly.

However, what was sacrificed for this was the lives of nearly one million civilians in Xue County of Qi State, as well as the lives of nearly 400,000 soldiers who died in battle on both sides.

It was such a huge sacrifice in exchange for these tens of thousands of weapons that barely reached the level of low-grade magical weapons.

Although these weapons are extremely low-level in the world of cultivating immortals, they belong to the novice stage, and they are cheap ones.

But in this world, it is already the number of magical weapons. In the whole world, all of them are added up. Among the only remaining weapons, there are no more than a thousand weapons that can reach the level of magical weapons.

It is only eleven in the hands of these soldiers, but this is the accumulation of thousands of years in this world, and these blood blades have been tempered in just a few months, and the two sides are completely different.

From this, we can see the horror of this blood forged weapon.

so……

"Kill! Kill me! It's these untouchables, ants, who dare to block the footsteps of our coalition army, kill the warriors of the coalition army, and kill them all, so as to appease the souls of the coalition army who died in battle!" In Qufu City, a man in a mighty armor, Riding a tall horse from the Western Regions under his crotch, the general wielding a blood-refined sword in his hand shouted loudly and frantically.

The general's face was excited, his face was ferocious, and his eyes were filled with crimson. While urging his horse to cross the street, he also waved the weapon in his hand, causing bursts of blood and screams.

Not only him like this, but behind this general, as long as there are soldiers wearing royal military uniforms and holding a bloody weapon in their hands, they will also shout crazily and continue to slaughter effectively.

Driven by them, the already crazy coalition soldiers became even crazier.

The soldier who originally wanted to rob some money and vent his male hormones by the way began to torture and kill civilians meaninglessly.

Vented the tyranny buried deep in his heart.

The reason why these Yuguo generals and soldiers did this was because of the blood sword in their hands.

They clearly felt that as the blood color of the blood sword devoured more and more blood souls, the color became brighter and redder.

The strength in their bodies, as well as the originally weak internal strength, also began to grow stronger.

This incomparably clear experience, as well as the feeling that their own strength is growing every minute, made them fascinated, as if they were addicted to drugs, and they couldn't extricate themselves.

Then, under the signal of their highest officer, Cao Cao, they went crazy, planning one after another that could effectively slaughter nearly 500,000 surrendered civilian soldiers in this city.

And the plan was put forward very quickly and implemented effectively. Some people even didn't talk about any plan at all, but just killed wherever they went.

As long as the person in front of him is not wearing a coalition uniform, he can clearly prove that he is on the side of the coalition. Then just one word, kill without mercy.

With the effective massacre of these soldiers, wailing rang out everywhere in the city.

These civilian soldiers who had surrendered were extremely horrified to find that even though they had surrendered and were ready to accept the abuse of the victors, those victors did not intend to let them go, but insisted on killing them all.

How can this be accepted by them? They are not people who are completely defenseless, and they also have some hidden weapons in their hands, just in case.

How could it be possible for those coalition forces to be slaughtered like pigs and sheep at will. Even pigs and sheep will still struggle before they die, let alone soldiers and civilians who were still resisting and had enough weapons in their hands?

Therefore, following the actions of the coalition forces. Except for the fact that the news was blocked at the beginning, the civilians in the city hadn't heard about the massacre of the people by the coalition forces, and they didn't react. Nearly 100,000 people were killed in a short time.

But later, when the news spread throughout the city, those people who were waiting to be captured all stood up and resisted.

After the siege, the coalition forces fell into the more tragic city and street battle.

Casualties suddenly became more serious.

How can you care about life and death when you know that you can't survive anyway? They all hold the idea of pulling a back even if they die, and fight to the death with those coalition forces who, in their eyes, are like hell devils.

This side's disregard for life and death is quite effective.

For a while, many coalition forces were defeated and retreated steadily.

But soon, the coalition army is an army after all, with a military organization, mobilization ability and massacre ability, which are far higher than these civilians.

Moreover, there is also a supervising team composed of the imperial army in the rear, so they dare not be lazy and think about running away.

Under this kind of pressure, the coalition forces quickly regained the lost places, and started repeated tug-of-war with the civilians in the city center and other places around a room and a street.
